data.title: Bayridge Resources Signs Binding Letter of Intent to Acquire Remaining 49% Interest in Baker Lake Uranium Project in Nunavut
data.description:
Proposed acquisition of remaining 49% eliminates joint venture structure and positions the Project for institutional scale capital

Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 19, 2026) - Bayridge Resources Corp. (OTCQB: BYRRF) (FSE: O0K) ("Bayridge" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has entered into a binding letter of intent (the "LOI") to acquire the remaining 49% of the issued and outstanding common shares of 1461433 B.C. Ltd. ("Privco") that it does not already own (the "Acquisition"). Privco is the beneficial owner of a 100% interest in the Baker Lake Uranium Project in the Kivalliq Region of Nunavut (the "Project"). Upon completion of the Acquisition, Privco will be a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, and the Company will indirectly own a 100% interest in the Project.

Highlights

  • 100% ownership: Upon completion of the Acquisition, Bayridge's indirect interest in the Project will increase from 51% to 100%.

  • Joint venture eliminated: The LOI provides for the waiver of the joint venture arrangements, including the related free-carried interest, contemplated by the November 2025 share purchase agreement.

  • Simplified ownership structure: Full ownership is expected to provide greater flexibility in advancing exploration and evaluating future financing and strategic opportunities for the Project.

  • Institutional-grade structure: A single-owner asset with no minority partner or carried interest gives a simpler profile for institutional investors, uranium-focused funds and potential strategic partners.

  • Substantially all share consideration: The consideration payable to the Vendors (as defined below) will consist of 14,000,000 common shares of the Company. The Company paid Privco a $10,000 non-refundable cash deposit upon execution of the LOI.

  • District-scale land package: 83 contiguous claims covering 619 km², about 60 km south of the town of Baker Lake, in the same Paleoproterozoic uranium district that hosts ATHA's Angilak and Orano's Kiggavik deposits.

Strategic Rationale: Positioning Baker Lake for Institutional Capital

Bayridge acquired its initial 51% interest in Privco on December 11, 2025 pursuant to a share purchase agreement entered into in November 2025 (the "Initial Agreement"). The Initial Agreement contemplated a joint venture arrangement under which the remaining 49% interest would be a free-carried interest until completion of a pre-feasibility study. Completion of the Acquisition would consolidate the Company's ownership of the Project and eliminate the contemplated minority and free-carried interests, providing the Company with sole control over the Project's exploration strategy, budgets and timing.

Management believes that consolidating ownership will simplify the Project's ownership structure and provide greater flexibility in evaluating future financing, strategic investment and partnership opportunities.

Saf Dhillon, President & Chief Executive Officer of Bayridge, commented: "Moving towards a 100% ownership of Baker Lake will be a defining step for Bayridge. When we secured our initial 51% last November, our goal was to build a district-scale uranium position in one of Canada's most prospective and under-explored basins. Consolidating full ownership is intended to give us a clean, single-owner asset with full control over how and when we advance it, which is exactly the profile institutional investors and strategic partners look for. We believe the long-term fundamentals for uranium remain compelling. We thank the Privco shareholders for their continued support and look forward to completing this acquisition promptly."

About the Baker Lake Uranium Project

The Project is an advanced-stage exploration opportunity supported by about 5,500 m of modern drilling, 23.5 km² of detailed surface grids and 7,851 line-km of basin-scale airborne geophysics. At 2025 cost equivalencies, this work represents over $7 million in exploration value (Fugro Airborne Surveys, 2008; Pacific Ridge Exploration Ltd., 2006; Pacific Ridge Exploration Ltd., 2007). Early work by Pan Ocean (1960s-1976) and Noranda (1978-1984) identified 20 uranium prospects along 75 km of the Baker Basin unconformity. The 2008 TEMPEST® radiometric and EM survey defined 30 priority targets, most of which remain untested (Fugro Airborne Surveys, 2008).

Pacific Ridge conducted drilling on the Project during 2006 and 2007. Selected historical drill results include:

  • (L7-07-08) 17.3 m of 0.30% U₃O₈
  • (L7-07-10) 10.0 m of 0.35% U₃O₈
  • (L7-07-06) 15.3 m of 0.20% U₃O₈, including 0.9 m of 2.74% U₃O₈
  • (KZ-06-02) 11.5 m of 0.31% U₃O₈, including 5.5 m of 0.56% U₃O₈

All drill intervals represent core lengths; true widths are unknown. Historical surface sampling also returned values of up to 1.83% U₃O₈. The reported maximum surface sample value is not necessarily representative of mineralization across the Project.

The historical exploration results summarized above were previously disclosed in the Company's news release entitled "Bayridge Resources Signs Definitive Agreement on Baker Lake Uranium Project in Nunavut" dated November 24, 2025, filed under the Company's profile on SEDAR+. Readers are referred to that news release, including its appendices, for supporting information concerning drill hole locations and orientations, sampling, sample preparation, analytical methods and quality assurance and quality control procedures.

Readers are also referred to the Company's most recently-filed technical report, a copy of which may be obtained under the Company's profile at www.sedarplus.ca, for a further discussion of the Company's QA/QC and data verification processes and procedures.

Terms of the Acquisition

The LOI was entered into between the Company and Privco and contemplates the acquisition by the Company of 915,327 common shares of Privco, representing the remaining 49% of Privco's issued and outstanding common shares, from the holders thereof (the "Vendors"). The Vendors are not parties to the LOI and are not bound to sell their shares solely by virtue of the LOI. Completion of the Acquisition requires all Vendors to execute a definitive share purchase agreement among the Company, Privco and the Vendors (the "Definitive Agreement"). Upon completion of the Acquisition, the Company will own all of the issued and outstanding shares of Privco.

As consideration for the shares of Privco to be acquired, the Company will issue an aggregate of 14,000,000 common shares of the Company (the "Consideration Shares"), to be allocated among the Vendors pro rata in accordance with their respective holdings of the shares being acquired, or as otherwise directed in writing by the applicable Vendor and permitted by applicable securities laws. The Consideration Shares will be subject to a statutory hold period of four months and one day from the date of issuance, or such other resale restrictions as may be required by applicable securities laws and Canadian Securities Exchange ("CSE") policies.

Upon execution of the LOI, the Company paid Privco a cash deposit of $10,000 (the "Deposit"). The Deposit is retained by Privco for its own account and is non-refundable in all circumstances, including if the LOI is terminated or the Acquisition is not completed for any reason, including failure to obtain required approvals. The Deposit is in addition to the consideration payable for the shares of Privco and will not be credited against or otherwise applied toward the Consideration Shares.

The LOI requires the definitive documentation to provide for the waiver and release, effective upon completion of the Acquisition, of the contemplated joint venture arrangements and related free-carried interest provisions under the Initial Agreement. Following completion of the Acquisition, the Vendors are expected to hold approximately 60% of the Company's issued and outstanding common shares. The Acquisition is not expected to result in the creation of a new control person of the Company.

Completion of the Acquisition is subject to the execution of the Definitive Agreement and customary closing conditions, including receipt of all required consents and the approval of the CSE. There can be no assurance that the Definitive Agreement will be executed or that the Acquisition will be completed on the terms described herein or at all.

The LOI provides for a 60-day exclusivity period during which Privco must deal exclusively with the Company in relation to the Acquisition. The Vendors are not bound by those exclusivity obligations.

Related Party Transaction

Mark Richardson, P.Geo., Vice President Exploration of the Company, is one of the Vendors and is expected to receive Consideration Shares in exchange for his common shares of Privco. His participation in the Acquisition constitutes a "related party transaction" within the meaning of Multilateral Instrument 61-101 - Protection of Minority Security Holders in Special Transactions ("MI 61-101"). The Company intends to rely on the exemptions from the formal valuation and minority shareholder approval requirements contained in sections 5.5(a) and 5.7(1)(a) of MI 61-101, respectively, on the basis that neither the fair market value of the subject matter of the Acquisition, nor the fair market value of the consideration therefor, insofar as it involves interested parties, exceeds 25% of the Company's market capitalization, calculated in accordance with MI 61-101.

Qualified Person

Mark Richardson, P.Geo., Vice President Exploration of the Company, is a "qualified person" as defined in National Instrument 43-101 - Standards of Disclosure for Mineral Projects and has reviewed and approved the technical content of this news release. Mr. Richardson is not independent of the Company.

The historical drill and surface-sampling information disclosed in this release has been compiled from publicly available Pacific Ridge exploration disclosures and Bayridge's previously published technical disclosure. The Qualified Person has reviewed these reported results against available historical and previously published information; however, the underlying historical sampling, analytical and assay data have not been independently confirmed through examination of all original laboratory certificates, resampling or reanalysis. The historical boulder-sample result has likewise not been independently confirmed by new sampling. Such independent field and laboratory verification has not been undertaken for this corporate transaction announcement, which does not report new exploration results. These limitations should be considered when interpreting the historical results; further verification would be required to support future reliance on individual historical results, as appropriate.

About Bayridge Resources Corp.

Bayridge Resources Corp. is a green energy company advancing its portfolio of Canadian uranium projects. The Company holds 51% of the Baker Lake Uranium Project, which covers 619 km² in the Kivalliq Region of Nunavut. The Company holds a 40% interest in the 1,337-ha Waterbury East project, which it operates as a joint venture with CanAlaska Uranium Ltd. , the holder of the remaining 60% interest and project operator. Waterbury East is located 25 km northeast of the Cigar Lake Mine in the northeastern Athabasca Basin region. There, geophysical surveys have identified a 7 km long conductivity corridor where mid-2000s drilling highlighted faulted and altered basement rock with local uranium enrichment. Large sections of this corridor remain untested.

Tel: 604-484-3031

Forward-looking information

This news release contains certain "forward-looking information" within the meaning of applicable Canadian securities legislation. Forward-looking information in this news release includes, but is not limited to, statements regarding: the negotiation and execution of the Definitive Agreement; the completion of the Acquisition and the terms thereof, including the issuance and allocation of the Consideration Shares; the Company becoming the indirect owner of a 100% interest in the Project; the elimination of the contemplated joint venture and free-carried interest arrangements; the anticipated benefits of the Acquisition, including greater control over the Project, preservation of cash and flexibility in pursuing exploration, financing, strategic investment and partnership opportunities; the Vendors' anticipated shareholdings following completion of the Acquisition and the expectation that no new control person will be created; the anticipated reliance on exemptions under MI 61-101; the receipt of CSE and other required approvals and consents; and the Company's future plans, objectives and activities in respect of the Project and its other uranium projects, including the evaluation and advancement of exploration targets.

data.title: Sterling drops from 20-month high versus euro
data.description:
By Stefano Rebaudo

Sterling pulled back from a 20-month high against the euro, though investors remained upbeat about the UK interest rate outlook and wary of headwinds facing the single currency ahead of key elections across Europe in 2027.

It edged lower against the greenback as the dollar index held near its highest level since April 2, 2025, when US President Donald Trump announced a sweeping tariff package.

British inflation rose to a one-year high in October, data showed on Wednesday, and the Bank of England, responding to the data, said it "will continue to set interest rates to make sure inflation returns to the 2% target and stays there".

The euro rose 0.23% to 83.65 pence after hitting 83.20 pence on Wednesday, its lowest level since March 28, 2025.

Sterling fell 0.2% to $1.31475 .

“We expect the euro/pound to hold around the 0.83 area on a 1-month view but see scope for a move down to the 0.82 area in the approach to the French Presidential election,” Jane Foley, senior forex strategist at Rabobank, said.

Concerns about France's fiscal trajectory could weigh on the euro, but a market gauge of the risk premium investors demand to hold French debt (DE10FR10=RR) has recently narrowed to around 150 basis points from a 15-year high of about 180 bps.

“A more hawkish Bank of England relative to the ECB over the coming months and PM Andy Burnham's efforts to get closer to Europe are two factors which should keep euro/pound offered,” Chris Turner, head of forex strategy at ING, said.

Britain set out the broad shape of a package of agreements it hopes to strike with the European Union at a summit later this week, including a youth experience program, a food trade deal and closer cooperation on carbon emissions.

Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey said that Britain's labour market no longer appeared to be loosening, although some slack remained.

BoE forecasts imply UK inflation will stay at or above 2% until the end of 2028, its longest such run since a 27-year stretch ended in 1994.

data.title: Orlen, Carlyle sign MoU on joint energy investments
data.description:
Poland's Orlen and US-based Carlyle Group signed a memorandum of understanding to pursue joint investments in oil and gas, renewable fuels and electricity, Orlen said on Thursday.

Poland has been aiming to become a hub for imports of liquefied natural gas from the US to supply the region, including Ukraine and Slovakia.

"We will invest in energy assets, in the petrochemical assets across Europe and across Western Europe as well," said Minister of State Assets Wojciech Balczun during the Partnership for Transatlantic Energy Cooperation conference in Warsaw.

"We're giving ourselves 90 days to translate this MoU into concrete actions," he added.

The import capacity of the Polish gas system stands at around 37.3 billion cubic metres per year, almost double domestic demand of about 20 bcm. The infrastructure under development will boost Poland's potential to become an access point for global gas supplies for countries in Central and Eastern Europe.

data.title: PB Fintech Falls 6% As Co-founder Alok Bansal To Exit Executive Role
data.description:
Shares of PB Fintech, the parent of Policybazaar and Paisabazaar, came under pressure on Thursday after the company announced that co-founder Alok Bansal would step down from his executive responsibilities. The stock, which fell as much as 6 per cent during the session, recovered a significant portion of its losses but continued to trade in the red.

Bansal, currently the company’s executive vice-chairman and whole-time director, will relinquish his executive positions on 31 March 2027. He will, however, remain on the board as a non-executive, non-independent director from 1 April 2027, according to a regulatory filing.

The company’s board approved the change in designation on Wednesday, following a recommendation from the Nomination and Remuneration Committee. The transition is subject to shareholder approval.

Bansal has decided to step back from day-to-day executive responsibilities due to personal reasons, the filing said. He has also confirmed that there is no other material reason behind the decision.

PB Fintech acknowledged Bansal’s contribution to the company over the past 18 years, crediting him with helping build and strengthen its businesses and leadership team.

The stock touched an intraday low of Rs 970.40, falling below its IPO issue price of Rs 980. It subsequently recovered and was trading 2.1 per cent lower at Rs 1,014.30.

data.title: Toshiba JSW Appoints Hiroyuki Tao As Managing Director
data.description:
The Toshiba veteran brings over three decades of experience in thermal power engineering, EPC execution and overseas power projects

Toshiba JSW Power Systems Private Limited, a joint venture between Japan's Toshiba Group and India's JSW Group, has appointed Hiroyuki Tao as its Managing Director, as the company looks to strengthen its engineering, manufacturing and project execution capabilities in India's power sector.

Tao brings more than three decades of experience within the Toshiba Group, having joined the organisation in 1993 after graduating from Hokkaido University with a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering.

Over the course of his career, he has developed expertise in thermal power engineering, overseas power plant projects, engineering and project management, and engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) execution. He has also held several leadership positions across Toshiba Corporation and its subsidiaries.

In his new role, Tao will focus on strengthening Toshiba JSW's capabilities across power-generation equipment, maintenance services and digital solutions, while exploring emerging opportunities in India's energy sector.

Commenting on his appointment, Tao said he would work with the Toshiba JSW team to enhance engineering, manufacturing, project execution and maintenance service capabilities. He added that the company would combine Toshiba's technology and quality management practices with its experience in the Indian market to improve power plant reliability and operational efficiency.

The company is also expanding its focus on digital technologies for power generation. It is currently executing an EtaPRO implementation project for NTPC Limited, covering 165 generating units, to support performance monitoring and analysis of power-generation assets.

Tao also highlighted Toshiba Group's work on decarbonisation technologies, including carbon capture, utilisation and storage (CCUS), which could help reduce carbon dioxide emissions from thermal power plants.

Toshiba JSW operates a heavy engineering manufacturing facility in Chennai, equipped with precision machinery and fabrication infrastructure for manufacturing, assembling and testing large components for the power sector and other industries.

The company plans to build on its existing manufacturing and engineering capabilities to explore opportunities across the power sector and other industrial segments.

data.title: Awfis Appoints Kumar Alok Gupta As Chief Business Officer
data.description:
Awfis Space Solutions Ltd. has appointed Kumar Alok Gupta as Chief Business Officer (CBO) to lead strategic demand and supply initiatives across its Managed Office and Coworking verticals. In his new role, he will focus on revenue expansion, institutional landlord partnerships and enterprise client growth across India.

Gupta brings over 24 years of experience in commercial real estate, with expertise in portfolio strategy, leasing transactions and risk management for global funds, institutional investors and large developers.

Before joining Awfis, Gupta served as Managing Director at Cushman & Wakefield, where he led the national agency leasing business with profit and loss (P&L) responsibility, focusing on large landlord mandates. Earlier, he was Associate Executive Director at CBRE India.

Commenting on the appointment, Amit Ramani, Chairman and Managing Director, Awfis Space Solutions, said the company expects Gupta's experience in institutional relationships and commercial real estate to support its growth across Managed Office and Coworking segments, particularly among Global Capability Centres (GCCs) and large enterprises.

Speaking on his appointment, Kumar Alok Gupta, Chief Business Officer, Awfis Space Solutions, said he would focus on strategic supply expansion, institutional leasing, landlord partnerships and workspace solutions for enterprises.

The appointment comes as Awfis looks to expand its presence in India's flexible workspace market. The company operates across 18 cities with more than 250 centres and serves over 3,700 clients across industries.

data.title: Cognizant Wins $175 Mn UK Rail Data Centre Contract
data.description:
The award follows a competitive bidding process involving five companies, including India's TCS and HCLTech

Cognizant has been selected by Network Rail Infrastructure Limited in the UK for a data centre infrastructure services contract valued at £133.2 million (approximately USD 175 million), according to a contract award notice published on the UK government's Find a Tender service.

The contract, titled DDaT Data Centre Infrastructure Services, is scheduled to run for nearly seven years, from 29 January 2027 to 26 January 2034. Cognizant Worldwide has been named as the selected supplier for the contract.

The procurement notice identifies four other companies that participated in the bidding process: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), HCL Technologies UK, DXC Technology and Atos IT Services UK. The authority received five bids, with Cognizant emerging as the selected supplier.

Scope Covers Core IT Infrastructure

The contract covers data centre infrastructure services for Network Rail's existing technology environment. Its scope includes infrastructure hosted across data centres, LAN and edge computing rooms, as well as cloud platforms.

The services will cover local area networks (LAN) and wide area networks (WAN), platforms, mainframes, servers and specified applications, along with the tools and services required to operate the infrastructure.

The contract award is currently subject to a standstill period ending 23 November 2026. The notice lists 27 January 2027 as the estimated date for signing the contract.

The award follows a competitive procurement process conducted under the UK's Procurement Act 2023.

data.title: Nilkamal Homes & Nilkamal Sleep Take Diwali Campaign To 40 Towns Through Mobile OOH
data.description:
Executed by Prathamprasanna OOH Media, the campaign deployed 62 branded vans covering more than 45,000 kilometres

Nilkamal Homes and Nilkamal Sleep took their Diwali advertising campaign across 40 towns through a multi-city mobile out-of-home (OOH) activation. Executed by Prathamprasanna OOH Media, the campaign deployed 62 branded vans across state capitals and upcountry markets, covering more than 45,000 kilometres during the festive period.

The activation combined planned route coverage with stationary placements at identified high-footfall locations. Rather than relying solely on moving vehicles, the campaign positioned vans at strategic locations throughout the day to increase visibility among local audiences.

The approach brought together mobile advertising and fixed-location exposure, extending the brands' presence across diverse markets beyond conventional outdoor formats.

Speaking about the campaign, Anshuman Dash, Marketing Manager, Nilkamal Limited, says, “The van promotion campaign provided us with an effective opportunity to extend the reach of Nilkamal Homes and Nilkamal Sleep across diverse markets during the Diwali season. The strategic inputs and deployment approach by Prathamprasanna OOH Media, particularly the combination of route coverage and carefully selected stationary locations, helped us enhance brand visibility and connect with consumers across 40 towns. We are pleased with the way the campaign was planned and executed.”

Rohit Yajnik, Chief Business Officer, Prathamprasanna OOH Media, says, “The success of a van promotion campaign is not measured by kilometers travelled alone, but by the quality of media selection and the audience reach it delivers. For Nilkamal Homes and Nilkamal Sleep, we identified strategic routes and high-footfall locations across 40 towns, combining mobility with planned stationary visibility. This ensured that every van functioned as an effective brand visibility platform. Our focus was to maximize reach and create meaningful brand impact, particularly during the highly cluttered festive season.”

The campaign highlights the use of mobile OOH to combine geographical reach with targeted visibility during high-activity festive periods.

data.title: TCI Express To Invest Rs 500 Cr In Infrastructure Over Next Five Years
data.description:
The company has opened three sorting centres in Ahmedabad, Lucknow and Kolkata, taking its total network of company-owned facilities to 28

TCI Express on Thursday announced a Rs 500-crore infrastructure expansion plan over the next five years and opened three sorting centres in Ahmedabad, Lucknow and Kolkata as part of its network expansion.

The company said the proposed investment would be directed towards its high-performing business verticals, including domestic air express, e-commerce express and surface express. It had invested Rs 500 crore in infrastructure over the previous seven years.

The expansion follows growth across the company's business segments during the September quarter of FY27. Domestic air express recorded 29.4 per cent year-on-year growth, while e-commerce express grew 51.6 per cent. Surface express registered growth of 9.4 per cent during the same period.

TCI Express Managing Director Chander Agarwal said domestic air express and e-commerce express had emerged as key growth drivers in FY27. He added that the next phase of expansion would focus on strengthening individual business verticals, improving operational efficiencies and expanding the company's network.

The company said the Rs 500-crore investment commitment over five years would support its infrastructure development plans and expansion across its business segments.

Three New Sorting Centres Added

The three newly opened sorting centres are located in Ahmedabad, Lucknow and Kolkata. With their addition, TCI Express will have a total of 28 company-owned sorting centres across its network.

The facilities will collectively cover approximately 4 lakh sq ft and are expected to increase shipment processing capacity and operational reach, the company said.

The Ahmedabad and Kolkata centres will be fully automated. With these additions, the company will have four fully automated sorting centres across its network.

The company said the automation would support shipment processing capacity, operational efficiency and service reliability.

The expansion is also expected to generate employment opportunities across the three regions.

TCI Express said the new infrastructure investment would be focused on strengthening the capabilities of its individual business verticals and supporting its expansion over the next five years.

data.title: Blackstone's 16% Stake In IIFL Finance To Strengthen Capital Base
data.description:
The proposed Rs 6,414 crore equity infusion is expected to raise IIFL Finance's standalone Tier 1 capital ratio to 25.7 per cent from 12.5 per cent, while its secured lending-focused business model is unlikely to change significantly

Blackstone Inc.'s proposed acquisition of a 16 per cent stake in IIFL Finance will strengthen the company's capital base and support its growth plans, with no immediate change expected in its business model, Fitch Ratings said on Thursday.

Fitch said the investment would strengthen IIFL Finance's regulatory Tier 1 capital ratio and improve its funding flexibility. The proposed transaction is not expected to have an immediate impact on the company's ratings, while the implications for its business strategy, risk appetite and growth trajectory will become clearer over time.

The rating agency said the fresh equity infusion of Rs 6,414 crore would broaden IIFL Finance's capital base, with its pro forma standalone Tier 1 capital ratio expected to more than double to 25.7 per cent from 12.5 per cent at the end of September 2026.

The capital infusion would provide resources for business expansion, technology investments and process improvements. It would also enable the company to reduce its dependence on wholesale and off-balance-sheet funding amid near-term interest rate volatility, Fitch said.

Fitch expects no significant change in IIFL Finance's business model, which is primarily focused on secured lending. The company has indicated plans to accelerate growth in its core product segments, particularly gold-backed lending, through branch expansion and higher asset utilisation per branch and employee.

The rating agency said these initiatives could support the company's earnings profile, provided it maintains adequate underwriting standards, risk management practices and cost controls.

Blackstone To Become Main Private Equity Shareholder

Fitch said Blackstone would effectively become IIFL Finance's main private-equity shareholder following the proposed transaction. This follows the exit of Fairfax Financial Holdings Ltd, which sold its 13.24 per cent stake in the company while retaining a 0.39 per cent holding.

The board of IIFL Finance had earlier approved a proposal to raise Rs 6,414 crore through a preferential issue. The proposed fundraising includes Rs 5,000 crore from Blackstone, Rs 1,264 crore from the company's promoters Nirmal Jain and R Venkataraman, and Rs 150 crore from Anchorage Capital.

Fitch said the changes in the company's shareholder base and board composition could influence its business strategy, risk appetite and growth trajectory. However, the substantial capital infusion and foreign investment would strengthen its capital position and funding flexibility.

On November 18, Fairfax sold 5.65 crore shares, representing a 13.24 per cent stake in IIFL Finance, through open market transactions for a total of Rs 3,488 crore. The buyers included SBI Mutual Fund, Nippon India Mutual Fund and Rimco India.

Fairfax To Fund IDBI Bank Acquisition

The proceeds from the stake sale are expected to help Fairfax finance its proposed acquisition of a 61 per cent stake in IDBI Bank.

Fairfax, led by Canadian billionaire Prem Watsa, had submitted a bid worth Rs 52,878 crore for the strategic sale of IDBI Bank. The government announced Fairfax as the successful bidder for the transaction last month.
